records.name: Alkene hydrogenation
records.temperature: room temperature or above, depending on the catalyst
records.medium: Ni, Pd or Pt as catalyst
modelNotes: In this teaching model, the double bond becomes a single bond and H atoms are added.

records.name: Alkene bromination
records.energy: often described as spontaneous for reactive alkenes; not predicted by this model
modelNotes: In this teaching model, Br is added to both C atoms of the double bond.

records.name: Electrophilic chlorination of benzene
modelNotes: In this teaching model, one H on the benzene ring is replaced by Cl.
